.. py:class:: RayJobHandle

   Handle for a submitted Ray task.


.. py:class:: RayBackend(address = None, num_cpus = None, num_gpus = None, memory_bytes = None, runtime_env = None)

   Ray execution backend.

   :param address: Optional Ray cluster address.
   :param num_cpus: Optional default CPU request for tasks.
   :param num_gpus: Optional default GPU request for tasks.
   :param memory_bytes: Optional default memory request for tasks.
   :param runtime_env: Optional Ray runtime environment.


   .. py:method:: submit(fn, job)

      Submit a single Ray job.



   .. py:method:: gather(handles)

      Collect Ray job results.



   .. py:method:: status(handle)

      Return Ray task status.



   .. py:method:: map(fn, jobs)

      Map a callable over Ray jobs while preserving order.
